# Amen Allah Ben Aissa
> Software Engineer | AI, Systems & Games


## About
I'm a software engineer and data science student. I build AI-powered tools, games, and the systems underneath them, from a C game engine and a DQN implemented by hand to a shipped encrypted desktop app and apps real people use. I like owning problems end to end and understanding why things work the way they do.


## Skills
- Programming Languages: C#, C, Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL
- Game Development: Unity, Godot, MonoGame, Raylib, Sokol, SDL2, ECS
- Web Development: ASP.NET, Django, Flask, Angular, React, Next.js, HTMX, Tailwind, Supabase, Tauri, HTML/CSS
- Mobile Development: React Native, Expo
- Machine Learning: PyTorch, LangChain, NLP, RAG, Multi-Agent AI, BERT
- Data & Analytics: Pandas, NumPy, Power BI, Row-Level Security, Data Visualization
- Tools & DevOps: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux, REST APIs, CI/CD, Netlify
- Spoken Languages: Arabic (Native), French (Fluent), English (Fluent)


## Experience

### Internship at SQUARE-IT (Jul 2025 - Sep 2025)
- Built a career-management module for the HRMaps HRMS during a 3-month internship, using ASP.NET (layered controllers, services, DTOs) and Angular with PrimeNG and Tailwind.
- Implemented CareerIntelligenceService: turns performance reviews, skills and tenure into promotion-readiness scores, attrition-risk predictions and skill-gap recommendations across HR, manager and employee dashboards.
- Designed a role-aware approval workflow where manager-initiated promotion and transfer requests skip the standard queue and route directly to HR.

## Projects

### [CredVault](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/credvault.html)
Tags: Rust, Tauri, Encryption, Desktop Application, CI/CD, React
Local-first, zero-knowledge credential manager shipped as a Rust and Tauri desktop app: Argon2id and AES-256-GCM, one encrypted file, no network calls, installers for Linux and Windows via CI/CD.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/credvault)
- [Github Releases (Download)](https://github.com/logmoon/credvault/releases)

### [Rental Property Manager](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/rental-property-manager.html)
Tags: React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, CI/CD, Mobile
React Native and Supabase app used by 10 family members and agents to manage rental houses and bookings, with offline access, JWT auth, push notifications and an EAS CI/CD pipeline shipping over-the-air updates.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/Location-Majdi-Ben-Aissa)

### [rAIs](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/rAIs.html)
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Unity, C#, RAG, LangChain, Blender, Python, Photoshop
AI president installation exhibited at TSYP12: a Blender-built 3D character in Unity with a custom lip-sync and expression system, driven by a Python RAG backend over speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

### [DQN From Scratch](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/dqn-from-scratch.html)
Tags: Reinforcement Learning, C, Deep Q-Network, Neural Networks, Sokol
Deep Q-Network implemented from scratch in C on a custom Sokol game stack: hand-written forward pass and backprop, experience replay, target networks and a training curriculum, applied to Pong.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/dqn-implementation-from-scratch)

### [Stock Boy](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/Stock_Boy.html)
Tags: Unity, C#, Commercial Game, 2D Game, Team Lead
Commercial 2D action-adventure in Unity, developed with Novel Bomb as sole in-engine programmer and lead developer on a 4-person team.
- [Website](https://novelbomb.com/stock-boy)
- [Itch (Play Demo)](https://novel-bomb.itch.io/stock-boy)

### [create-project](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/create-project.html)
Tags: AI Agents, Developer Tooling, OpenCode, Node.js, CLI
CLI that scaffolds an opencode-first project with agent memory, context files and review workflow, the same workflow CredVault was built through.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/create-project)
